meta.title: Villa Alba — Franciacorta
meta.description: A private villa among the vineyards of Franciacorta, a few minutes from Lake Iseo. Four bedrooms, garden, swimming pool and outdoor dining table.

hero.kicker: Franciacorta, among vineyards and the lake
hero.title: Villa Alba
hero.subtitle: A private house set among the vineyards of Franciacorta, a few minutes from Lake Iseo.

villa.title: 394 sqm designed for togetherness
villa.intro: Villa Alba spans several levels between the living area, four bedrooms and a spacious basement floor, comfortably welcoming up to 8 guests.

master.name: Independent Master Bedroom
master.description: With its own separate entrance from the rest of the house and a private bathroom, for complete privacy.

double1.name: Double Bedroom
double1.description: A bright room with a double bed, overlooking the surrounding greenery.

double2.name: Double Bedroom with Private Bathroom
double2.description: Double bed with an en-suite private bathroom, for a more secluded stay.

twin.name: Twin Bedroom
twin.description: Two three-quarter beds, ideal for friends or children.

bathrooms.title: The Bathrooms
bathrooms.description: In addition to the private en-suite bathrooms, the villa offers two further large shared bathrooms for guests.

cucina.title: Kitchen
cucina.description: A fully equipped open-plan kitchen, connected to the living room, made for cooking together during the stay.

salaDaPranzo.title: Dining Room
salaDaPranzo.description: A bright dining area to share meals, comfortably seating all guests of the villa.

soggiorno.title: Living Room
soggiorno.description: A spacious living room at the entrance of the house, the heart of the living area and the gathering point for guests.

piscina.title: Swimming Pool
piscina.description: A private pool surrounded by greenery, perfect for cooling off between vineyard tours.

esterno.title: Garden & Outdoors
esterno.description: A large private garden with an outdoor dining table, to enjoy Franciacorta evenings in the open air.

amenities.title: Amenities
items: Air conditioning throughout the house and in the living area
Garage with two covered parking spaces

territorio.title: Among vineyards, wineries and Lake Iseo
territorio.intro: Villa Alba is located in Erbusco, in the heart of Franciacorta: one of Italy's most renowned wine regions, dotted with historic wineries and bordering the shores of Lake Iseo. A landscape to discover by bike, on horseback, or glass in hand.
territorio.poiNote: A selection of local wineries and riding stables: the full, up-to-date list is curated directly by the property.

pois.name: Historic Villages of Erbusco and Surroundings
pois.distance: a few minutes on foot or by car

vini.title: A selection of Franciacorta to discover
vini.intro: A small selection of local labels, available on request during your stay.

attivita.title: Experience Franciacorta with us
attivita.intro: Wine tastings, boat trips and other experiences available on request during your stay.

gallery.title: Villa Alba in images
gallery.intro: The spaces of the villa, the surrounding vineyards, Lake Iseo and the wineries of Franciacorta.
